LESSON: ISLAMIC MANNERS OF DRESSING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1.2: Islamic Manners of Dressing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Islamic Manners of Dressing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How should a Muslim dress?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam
2. observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah
3. appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ISLAMIC MANNERS OF DRESSING
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Islamic Manners of Dressing helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: ISLAMIC MANNERS OF DRESSING
Study Islamic Manners of Dressing like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam

What this means
In this part you learn to describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Islamic Manners of Dressing” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah

What this means
In this part you learn to observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Islamic Manners of Dressing in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Islamic Manners of Dressing is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Islamic Manners of Dressing” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Islamic Manners of Dressing in your own words. (skill: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Islamic Manners of Dressing to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam.
3. Practise this skill: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Islamic Manners of Dressing from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Islamic Manners of Dressing: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Islamic Manners of Dressing?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How should a Muslim dress?
2. What is the importance of the Islamic code of dress?
3. What are some of the dressing trends that should be avoided by a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Islamic Manners of Dressing means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam.
5. Be able to: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
